openai.plan: ChatGPT subscription with Codex included (subscription-specific allowances; exact account allowance displayed in usage dashboard)

limits.applies_to: Codex workload usage in a rolling 5-hour window; enforced as a variable usage allowance, not fixed request count
Codex weekly usage allowance; exact allowance/reset shown in account usage dashboard

reset.note: Five-hour usage window is rolling. An additional weekly limit may also apply and resets according to the account-specific time shown in Settings > Usage/dashboard; the weekly window is not documented with a universal UTC weekday/time. Usage is workload/allowance-based, affected by model, context, task complexity, tools, and local versus cloud execution, not a published fixed request count. GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna use differing allowance rates: official estimates show Plus local messages per 5 hours Sol 15-150 versus Luna 350-3,000, with corresponding plan-specific estimates; usage dashboard is authoritative.

openai.notes: Codex and ChatGPT Work share the available allowance where enabled. Official public materials describe model-dependent message estimates, not token quotas or fixed requests. The user-specific dashboard or CLI /status is the authoritative remaining allowance and reset. GPT-6 Sol generally consumes substantially more allowance per comparable workload than GPT-6 Luna. No exact universal weekly amount/reset time is published.

limits.applies_to: Inline code completions; Free monthly completions allowance
GitHub AI Credits allowance for model-based features; Free allowance exists but the official plan/billing pages consulted do not state its numeric amount

reset.note: Monthly AI credit allowance resets at 00:00:00 UTC on the first day of each calendar month, independent of subscription billing date; unused included credits do not carry over. Copilot Free model access is auto model selection only. Claude models are not selectable on Free; Free only offers automatic model selection.

github-copilot.notes: Free has 2,000 code completions per month plus an AI Credits allowance for AI-model features. The numeric Free AI Credits amount is not specified on the official billing page. Free models are accessed through automatic model selection only; the documented selectable Claude model list is for paid plans, so do not treat Claude as an included Free selectable model. Model-specific consumption in AI credits is token/model dependent.

limits.applies_to: Per-model RPM on models listed in Groq's Free Plan rate-limit table; exact limit varies by model
Per-model RPD on openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-safeguard-20b, and qwen/qwen3.8-27b; other models have model-specific limits
Per-model TPM for the listed GPT OSS and Qwen models; other models have model-specific limits
Per-model TPD for the listed GPT OSS and Qwen models; other models have model-specific limits

reset.note: Groq documents per-minute and per-day counters, and exposes per-counter reset countdowns in response headers (x-ratelimit-reset-requests and x-ratelimit-reset-tokens); limits are organization-level and model-specific. Daily reset is a rolling/countdown interval as communicated by response headers; no universal fixed UTC reset time is documented. Values shown are only examples/base limits and current exact organization limits are on the Console Limits page.

groq.notes: Groq limits apply at organization level (shared among its users/keys), while thresholds vary by model. Free Plan table gives different values for audio and other models; the listed 30 RPM/1,000 RPD/8K TPM/200K TPD values are for the specified GPT OSS/Qwen family only, not universal values. Account-specific limits and countdown headers should be used by a scheduler. Cached tokens do not count toward rate limits.

cloudflare-workers-ai.plan: Workers Free (Workers Paid also receives the same free daily allocation)

limits.applies_to: Total Workers AI neurons across account; free daily allocation; Workers Paid charges above this amount
Default text generation task rate limit; varies by task type and model, and models requiring Workers Paid have distinct account/model limits

reset.note: Daily Neuron allowance resets at 00:00 UTC. The 10,000 neurons/day allocation is shared at account level and counts inference usage; exceeding it on Workers Free causes further operations to fail. Requests/minute throttles are separately applied by task type/model.

cloudflare-workers-ai.notes: Workers AI pricing states 10,000 Neurons per day at no charge for Free and Paid. Neurons represent model compute and are not tokens in the usual LLM-token sense. Published task-specific RPM limits are separate from the daily neuron allowance; text generation default is 300 RPM, while paid-required models may be 20 RPM on standard billing or 50 RPM using prepaid AI Gateway credits, per account and model.
